authority_boundary.offline_fixture: Bundled roles, timestamps, and evidence references are trusted synthetic replay facts only.
authority_boundary.production: The authenticated backend derives actor, role, and event time; clients cannot self-assert them. Provider and human evidence references require separately authenticated adapters before operational use.
authority_boundary.receipt: Hash chaining detects mutation of retained bytes; it is not a signature or provider authentication.

states.CLEAR: No active writer and no prior-send reopen fence.
states.LEASED: Exactly one authenticated worker owns a bounded lane until release, system expiry, provider outcome, or hold.
states.SENT_DNR: Provider evidence was retained for a send; exact lane is do-not-resend until a genuine human event.
states.DEAD_ROUTE: Provider evidence was retained for route failure; route failure is not buyer rejection and the exact route remains blocked.
states.HUMAN_EVENT_REOPEN: One evidenced human event reopened one bounded next-action slot; release or expiry returns here rather than CLEAR.
states.HOLD: Authenticated operator fence; no lease acquisition is allowed.

invariants: lane identity is exact-field, NFKC-normalized, control-free, and deterministic
event ids are unique at the engine boundary and event time never moves backward
production actor role and event time are backend-derived rather than client-authored
at most one unexpired lease exists for a collision key
only the active unexpired lease holder may release or record provider SENT or BOUNCE
only SYSTEM may expire a lease and expiry requires backend time at or after lease_expires_at
an expired lease blocks new acquisition until SYSTEM performs explicit recovery
SENT hard-fences the exact lane against duplicate acquisition
HUMAN_EVENT opens one next-action slot; release or expiry preserves that reopen fence
provider bounce is DEAD_ROUTE, never buyer rejection
every accepted or denied semantic event emits a hash-chained receipt binding normalized lane and all decision evidence
receipt digests are integrity checks, not signatures or external-provider truth
